collectorUrl.title: Collector URL
collectorUrl.description: Base URL of the collector Function App, e.g. https://<functionHostname>

keyId.title: HMAC key ID
keyId.description: Key ID matching the collector setting HMAC_KEYS__<keyId> (KEY1 by default).

sharedSecret.title: HMAC shared secret
sharedSecret.description: Base64 HMAC key (the HmacKey1 secret in Key Vault).

flushIntervalMs.title: Send interval (ms)
flushIntervalMs.description: How often queued events are sent. Minimum 30000 (Chrome alarm limit).
